input.answer: With the defaults (500 ₪ a month, 7% a year), after 8 years I'd have about 68,853 ₪ "נשאר בידיים" on 48,000 ₪ I put in. For 4 years the calculator gives no number at all, because it says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים". Taking it out before 6 years means paying tax.

stuck.where: Calculator after moving the slider to 4
stuck.why: The fund bars for 1–5 years are empty. The only number on screen was 25,725 and I couldn't tell what it was, because the round up-arrow button covered its label.
The input fields swapped places and moved sideways, so the deposit box ended up where a different box had been.
There are 6 numbers in a row, and the first one my eye landed on (from the right) was 55,471. That one is the comparison, not the fund. The fund's number is the white bar, 68,853.

used: The orange note about no calculation before 6 years
skimmed: The intro under 'מה זה' (only took in 'אחרי 6 שנים... למשוך... בלי מס')
The breakdown bars: החזר המס הוסיף, התשואה הוסיפה, המס לקח
skipped: The 'שווה לדעת' and 'מי מציע ומי מצטרף' tabs
The הכנסה חייבת, return and fee fields (left on defaults)
unsure_meaning: 25,725 at 4 years (label hidden by the button)
The colours teal/yellow/grey in the small chart (guessed: return, tax refund, deposits)
not_found: Any amount for withdrawing after 4 years as self-employed

findings.what: There's no number for 4 years for self-employed. All the chart shows is empty dashed bars and an orange note.
The floating round up-arrow button covers the label of the right-hand comparison bar.
After switching to עצמאים the fields jump around and swap places.
Reading from the right, the first big number is the securities-account comparison (55,471), not the fund. It's easy to grab the wrong number.
